title: SpawnSubagent
description: Spawn a subagent with its own context window and tool registry. The subagent runs the same agent loop but with a fresh context. Returns the subagent's final summary (not the full transcript). Useful for decomposing complex tasks.

task.description: A self-contained description of the subtask. The subagent does NOT see the parent's context, so the task must include all necessary context (file paths, requirements, etc.).

tools.description: Optional list of tool names the subagent can use. Default: all tools. Use a restricted list to limit blast radius (e.g. ['read_file', 'grep'] for a read-only investigation).

model.description: Optional model override for the subagent (e.g. 'anthropic/claude-3-5-sonnet' for a harder task). Default: same model as the parent.

max_turns.description: Maximum number of turns the subagent can run. Default 10. Use a higher limit for complex subtasks.

isolated_worktree.description: If true, the subagent runs in a separate git worktree. Use for parallel subagents that may write to the same files.
